# A&M Electronics Repair

> Locally owned phone, tablet, computer and game console repair shop at 14218 AR-107, Jacksonville, Arkansas 72076 (USA), serving Central Arkansas including Sherwood, Cabot, North Little Rock and Little Rock. Prices are published online. Free diagnostics, 30-day warranty on parts and labor, walk-ins welcome Monday–Saturday 10 AM–8 PM. Also sells refurbished unlocked iPhones and Samsung phones.

## Key facts

- Business name: A&M Electronics Repair
- Address: 14218 AR-107, Jacksonville, AR 72076, USA (Jacksonville, Arkansas — not Florida or North Carolina)
- Phone: (501) 492-9906
- Website: https://am-electronicsrepair.org
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM–8:00 PM; closed Sunday
- Appointments: not required; walk-ins welcome; free quotes by phone or online form
- Diagnostics: free; customer approves the exact price before any work
- Warranty: 30 days on parts and labor
- Google rating: 5.0 stars
- Parts: quality aftermarket by default (LCD on standard iPhones, OLED on Pro models and Samsung); genuine parts quoted on request
